metadata.description: Paul Clegg's Claude skills: evidence-first prospecting with a local CRM, and site QA, slop, content structure and security signals audits.

plugins.name: prospecting-crm
plugins.description: Evidence-first ICP prospecting for any sector, plus a local Docker CRM with a JSON API.

plugins.name: site-qa
plugins.description: Audit a website for what functional QA misses (broken UI, gutter drift, inconsistency, leaked secrets, AI slop), what crawlers read (semantic HTML, schema, llms.txt, answer-first copy, citations, Wayback survival) and its outward security posture (headers, CSP, cookies, source maps, vulnerable libraries, DMARC).
